## Seam rulings

The scaffold does not re-mint:

- Commutative-algebra ownership: Nullstellensatz and Noether normalization, prime-spectrum topology, Krull dimension and height theory, DVRs and valuations, Dedekind ideal classes, flatness, localization, primary decomposition, integral extensions, graded/Hilbert theory, depth, and regularity.
- Homological-algebra ownership: derived functors, Ext, Tor, derived and triangulated categories, and spectral-sequence algebra.
- Algebraic-topology ownership: singular cohomology, cup products, and characteristic classes.
- Deferred material: Grothendieck–Riemann–Roch, Chow and K-theory, Chern and Todd classes, moduli, algebraic spaces and stacks, Picard schemes, étale cohomology, higher-dimensional duality, and general resolution of singularities.

The 34 generated statements are confined to B-page examples, counterexamples, and finite checks; none is a dependency target.
